_comment: Every number that appears on the landing page lives here, once, with the
kind of statement it is (ADR-038 Decision 1) and — for a cited fact — the
source whose own wording it matches. The build reads this file to fill in
copy and to generate the squares/ticks; scripts/check-devices.mjs reads the
built HTML and refuses to pass if a rendered count and this file disagree.
Nothing here is a placeholder: if a figure cannot be defended at this level
of care, it does not get an entry, and the page does not get a device.

variantA.headline: of US adults aged 16–74 score at PIAAC Level 2 or below — about 130 million people.
variantA.citation: Gallup, 2020 analysis of OECD PIAAC data, for the Barbara Bush Foundation.
variantA.deviceCaption: 54 squares in 100, at PIAAC's own levels — not a school grade.

variantB.headline: of US adults read at a level where they can compare, contrast and reason about what they have read.
variantB.citation: National Center for Education Statistics, U.S. results from the OECD's PIAAC survey, 2017.

session.headline: A session is about six minutes.
session.deviceCaption: six minutes, not a fraction of anything else.

mechanism.headline: A word you tap comes back until it’s yours.
mechanism.deviceCaption: no figure here — the mechanism replaces one that would have had to be invented (ADR-038 Decision 4).
